mapper.sql: FROM AUTOBIOGRAPHY A JOIN CONTENT_MASTER CM ON CM.CONTENT_ID = A.CONTENT_ID WHERE CM.IS_DELETED = 'N'

A.AUTOBIOGRAPHY_ID AS ID, A.CONTENT_ID, CM.USER_ID, A.TITLE, A.PERIOD, A.SUMMARY, A.CONTENT, A.STATUS, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CM.CREATED_AT) * 1000 AS CREATED_AT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CM.UPDATED_AT) * 1000 AS UPDATED_AT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AUTOBIOGRAPHY (AUTOBIOGRAPHY_ID, CONTENT_ID, TITLE, PERIOD, CONTENT, SUMMARY, STATUS) VALUES (#{id}, #{contentId}, #{title}, #{period}, #{content}, #{summary}, #{status})
mapper.update:
UPDATE AUTOBIOGRAPHY A JOIN CONTENT_MASTER CM ON CM.CONTENT_ID = A.CONTENT_ID
A.TITLE = #{title}, A.PERIOD = #{period}, A.SUMMARY = #{summary}, A.CONTENT = #{content}, A.STATUS = #{status},
WHERE A.AUTOBIOGRAPHY_ID = #{id} AND CM.USER_ID = #{userId} AND CM.IS_DELETED = 'N'
